reviews.text: Amazing vets, we can not recommend them enough and affordable plans.

Amazing team,  happy to recommend this veterinaire clinic. Every team member is super caring.  My dog is always VERY happy and even eager to going into the clinic, we both get such a lovely warm welcome.  I've always been able to get an appointment at my convenient and short notice emergency appointment are managed really well, I've never left waiting and worrying.
The Vets are very knowledgeable, super respectful of my dog's particular needs and they are very patient with me, answering any number of random questions.  All treatments options are discussed in layman's terms, with clear pro's/con's given for each.  Thank you all for taking such wonderful care of my precious pet, with a big shout out to Nicci (vet) and Suzanne (front desk) in particular 💖 🐶🐾🐾

The vet seemed incompetent because she couldn’t check if the cat was neutered with a physical exam and wanted to cut the animal open to perform “exploratory” surgery which would lead to greater costs.
I wouldn't bring a goldfish to this vet, the secretary should also stay in her lane and stop thinking she's a vet as well.
First time in Priory vets with my dog. Very warm and welcoming staff. Thank you for looking after Daisy today.

We brought our dog here for over 4 years, but due to a house move, we have changed to a more local vet. All of the Staff in Priory are incredibly kind and understanding. Our dog was not the most compliant patient but Nicola and her Team always took their time to give him the best care possible.

Thank you,
Loki :)
Couldn’t praise them highly enough they are absolutely brilliant and so professional. They are excellent.
